messages.content: 你能使用 get_stock_prices 函數來檢索蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價嗎？。

function.name: get_stock_prices
function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

companies.description: List of companies to retrieve stock prices for.

duration.description: Time duration to retrieve stock prices for. E.g., '1 week', '2 weeks', '1 month', etc.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to use the get_stock_prices function to retrieve stock prices for Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Tesla over durations 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 weeks, 1 month. The function signature expects an object with keys "companies" (string array) and "duration" (string). But we need to call it multiple times? The user says "retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration". They want separate calls for each duration? We can interpret as they want to retrieve for each company across those durations. So we might need to call the function four times, once per duration. Or maybe we can pass all companies and one duration at a time. The user didn't specify how many calls. We could ask clarifying question: do they want separate calls or combined? But the instruction says "If you have no idea what the user wants, ask them." But we have enough info: they want to retrieve stock prices for Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Tesla for durations 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 weeks, 1 month. That implies four separate calls. So we should call get_stock_prices four times.

We need to output JSON with key "function_calls" containing list of calls. Each call has name and arguments. We'll produce four calls:

Call 1: companies ["Apple"], duration "1 week"
Call 2: companies ["Microsoft"], duration "2 weeks"
Call 3: companies ["Amazon"], duration "3 weeks"
Call 4: companies ["Tesla"], duration "1 month"

But maybe they want all companies together? The wording: "retrieve stock prices for Apple, Microsoft, Amazon and Tesla respectively in 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 weeks and 1 month time ranges." That suggests mapping: Apple -> 1 week, Microsoft -> 2 weeks, Amazon -> 3 weeks, Tesla -> 1 month. So yes separate calls.

Thus produce JSON accordingly.
